short.q: State two functions of fat in the body.
short.model: It is an energy store and provides insulation or protection for organs.

short.q: Explain why an athlete needs protein.
short.model: Protein repairs and builds muscle tissue after training.

short.q: Describe two effects of dehydration on a performer.
short.model: Heart rate increases and the performer feels tired or gets cramp.
If more energy is taken in than is used, the extra is stored as fat, causing weight gain.

short.q: Why does a teenage athlete need more energy than a sedentary adult?
short.model: The teenager uses energy in exercise and for growth, whereas the sedentary adult uses less.
